user.title: SB Scheduler
user.description:
Day-sets are named groups of dates — Workday, School Day, Trash Day — that schedules can run against. Pick a workday calendar and Workday and Non-workday are created for you; add a days-off calendar too and time off will cancel a workday, while an entry titled "Workday" reinstates one.

The Workday integration publishes a workday calendar (typically calendar.workday_sensor_us_calendar). Leave both empty to start with just Daily and Weekend.

abort.single_instance_allowed: SB Scheduler is already set up.

add.title: Add a day-set
add.description:
A day-set is a named group of dates. Start from weekdays, calendars, typed dates, or another day-set; then optionally narrow it to a cadence or an ordinal.

Precedence is Always › Cancelled › Sources. Dates accept single days and ranges: 2026-12-25, 2027-06-05..2027-08-17

sources.name: Sources — where the dates come from

data_description.weekdays: Leave empty if the day-set comes entirely from a calendar or another day-set.
data_description.base_day_set: Start from that day-set's dates — e.g. Monday, to build "first Monday of the month" without a calendar.
data_description.base_calendars: e.g. the Workday integration's calendar, or the trash-collection calendar.

cancelled.name: Cancelled — what takes a day back out

data.exclude_match: Only cancel when the entry matches

data_description.exclude_calendars: e.g. a days-off calendar for time off.
data_description.exclude_match: Optional text matched against an event's title or description. Leave empty to cancel on any entry.

data.force_match: Only force when the entry matches

data_description.force_calendars: These win over everything, including the cancellations above.
data_description.force_match: e.g. "Workday", so only a days-off entry named that reinstates a workday.

pick.name: Pick — narrow to a cadence, an ordinal, or certain months
pick.description: Both kinds of pick count ELIGIBLE dates, not calendar days: "every other trash day" follows a holiday shift, and "last workday of the month" is holiday-aware.

data_description.pick_every: For "every Nth". Every 3rd day on Daily; every 14th day from a Tuesday is every other Tuesday.
data_description.pick_anchor: Required for "every Nth". The first eligible date on or after it starts the count; nothing before it is included.
data_description.months: Applied after the pick. "First Monday" plus November gives the first Monday of November.

data.invert: Invert (every date NOT in this set)

data_description.invert: Turns Workday into Non-workday without configuring it twice.
data_description.offset_days: Moves every date in the set. -1 gives "the night before"; +1 after the first Monday of November gives Election Day. Applied last.
data_description.expose_calendar: Off is right for a derived set like "every other Tuesday" that nobody needs to see in the Calendar panel. It stays selectable in the card either way.

pick_remove.title: Remove a day-set
pick_remove.description: Its calendar entity is removed too. Schedules using it, and day-sets built on it, will stop matching.

error.invalid_dates: Could not read those dates. Use YYYY-MM-DD, separated by commas, with ranges written as YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD.
error.base_cycle: That day-set is built on this one (directly or through others), which would loop forever.
error.base_missing: That base day-set no longer exists.

options.every: Every Nth eligible date, from a starting date
options.nth_of_month: The Nth (or last) eligible date of each month

query_day_set.name: Query day-set
query_day_set.description: Ask whether a date is in a day-set, and when the next matching date is.

day_set.name: Day-set
day_set.description: The day-set id, shown on its calendar entity.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Recompute every day-set now, instead of waiting for the nightly refresh.

set_day_set.name: Set day-set
set_day_set.description: Create a day-set (no id) or update one (with id). Same fields and same rules as the Configure form; the change is live after a short reload.

id.name: Id
id.description: Leave empty to create; give an existing id to update.

base_day_set.name: Built on
base_day_set.description: Id of another day-set to start from.

remove_day_set.name: Remove day-set
remove_day_set.description: Delete a day-set. Refused while any schedule or day-set still depends on it.
